name: Boku Dake no Hokenshitsu
source:
A succession race breaks out at a school between Motonori, a son of the principal, and Rinko, his cousin. According to the former principal, the one who gets a son/daughter of heir will win the race. One day, Mana, a sick-room teacher, comes to the school. Due to her kindness and beauty, she soon gets popular among male students. The main character is Yuu, who is a dropout student. He falls in love with her and often visits the sick-room to meet her. He also starts studying hard not to flunk. Mana gradually falls in love with Yuu.... On the other hand, Motonori tries to make a baby with Mana, his fiancee, but she doesn't let him.... Yuu also gets involved in the race.... Well, will he be able to graduate from school...? What will happen between Yuu and Mana...?

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090614055055/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/54/products_id/1012685]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
学校里，校长之子元典和他的表弟凛子之间爆发了一场继承人争夺战。据前校长称，获得继承人儿子/女儿的人将赢得比赛。有一天，病房老师玛娜来到学校。由于她的善良和美丽，她很快就受到了男生的欢迎。主角是优，一名辍学学生。他爱上了她，经常去病房看望她。他也开始努力学习，以免不及格。真奈逐渐爱上了悠……另一方面，元则试图与未婚妻真奈生孩子，但她不让他……悠也参与了比赛……那么，他能从学校毕业吗……？优和玛娜之间会发生什么……？
